subject: reasoning
question: J, K, L, M and N are sitting on a bench. J is the immediate neighbour of K, M is the immediate neighbour of N, and J is not sitting with L who sits on the right end of the bench. J sits to the right of M and N. M sits to the right of N. In which position is J sitting?
solution:
**Given : **

 
• **J, K, L, M and N are sitting on a bench. **
 
• **As the direction is not given, so all of them are facing north is assumed.**

**Explanation :**

1) J is not sitting with L who sits on the right end of the bench.

Here the position of J is not known yet but where J cannot be positioned is given. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26c4a9b1f7d1b00c23a4dece1dadd78d9d1aaa49d50377d1d318686bbdf57e02.png] 

2) J sits to the right of M and N.

3) M sits to the right of N.

4) M is the immediate neighbor of N.

As where J cannot be positioned is already given, therefore there is only possible position for J. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/049c9b67f2c19fb0201606332a2a25e775121f00f04cf2b9f75a2034d53270ec.png] 

5) J is the immediate neighbor of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5b7d8b8663ba6db5e9e215127a657fb2fecd28caa3b1b3f695b77b9b61c45ab.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement J third from the left end.

Hence, **"Third from the left"** is the correct answer.
